learning_outcomes.text: Determine the properties of humid air.
Carry out the study of thermal loads and the study of condensations of a room to be refrigerated or air-conditioned.
Describe the operation of mechanical vapor compression refrigeration systems in their different variants and of absorption refrigeration systems.
Calculate the main parameters of a mechanical vapor compression refrigeration system and an absorption refrigeration system and provide their basic dimensioning.
Describe the operation of the heat pump and calculate its main parameters and provide its basic dimensioning.
Describe the different types of air conditioning systems, calculate their main parameters and provide their basic dimensioning.
Calculate the incident solar radiation on a surface of interest.
Describe the operation of a solar thermal collector and identify the different types that exist.
Calculate the thermal energy production of a solar thermal collector.
Describe typical solar thermal installations (for domestic hot water production, pool heating, refrigeration, and air conditioning).
Perform the basic design and dimensioning of typical solar thermal installations (for domestic hot water production, pool heating, refrigeration, and air conditioning).

syllabus_topics: Calculation of thermal loads. Condensation study.
Study of practical application in heat transfer.
teaching_methods: Theoretical classes with presentations and other tools (full group)
Attendance at tutorials (presential and/or virtual, reduced group)
Laboratory or computer room practices (reduced group)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam on topics 1 and 2 (Continuous Assessment - EC1)
Attendance to practices and practice reports (Continuous Assessment - EC2)
Group work with presentation (Continuous Assessment - EC3)
Written exam on topics 3 to 9 (Continuous Assessment - EC4)
Written exam on all course content (Single Assessment - EU1)
Attendance to practices and practice reports (Single Assessment - EU2)

assessment_rules: For Continuous Assessment (EC), a minimum score of 40% (1.2 for theoretical concepts, 2.8 for exercises) is required in each part of exams EC1 and EC4. A combined score of at least 3.75 from (0.25*EC1 + 0.5*EC4) is required, otherwise the overall grade is 'Fail'. A minimum grade of 5.0 in each EC2 practice activity is required, otherwise the overall grade is 'Fail' (or 4.0 if the weighted average is >= 5.0). For Single Assessment (EU), a minimum score of 4.0 in EU1 and 5.0 in each EU2 practice activity is required, otherwise the overall grade is 'Fail'. Regardless of the assessment model or call, a grade below 4.0 in the written exam (EC1/EC4/EU1) results in an overall 'Fail' grade for the course, with the numeric grade corresponding to that exam.
